dedupe_keys.name: vmgd volcanic alert levels and bulletins vanuatu

description: The Vanuatu Meteorology and Geo-hazards Department publishes a volcanoes page with the latest Volcanic Alert Level for each monitored volcano, most active first, and the Volcanic Alert Bulletins it issues whenever volcanic activity changes significantly. On the day read the levels were East Epi (submarine) 1, Yasur on Tanna 2, Lopevi 2, Benbow and Marum on Ambrym 2, Manaro Voui on Ambae 3, Mount Garet on Gaua 2 and Suretamatai on Vanua Lava 1, and bulletin number 18 of 2026 reported continued unrest at the East Epi submarine volcano. The page also shows recent images from volcano cameras and seismic drums of the last 24 hours for Yasur, Lopevi, Benbow and Marum and Manaro Voui. Access is free on the web; no licence is stated and no machine-readable feed was seen. Caveats: the page gives the current state only, so past alert levels must be taken from the bulletins; the alert level scale itself was not read. Coverage is Vanuatu. It supports volcanic hazard exposure analysis for island airports, ports, roads and communities; related records are the Reykjanes volcanic hazard map of IMO and the IG-EPN Ecuador seismic and volcanic data.
